lines.text: The victims of Pompeii were not killed by falling rock.
The mountain stood five miles from the town, across the bay.
Pumice came down on the roofs, grain after grain, hour after hour.
The road to the coast was still open.
A current of hot ash swept down and buried the streets, and the heat killed them fast.
Ash sealed each body, and the body decayed away.
Diggers poured plaster into the cavity, and the shape of a person came back.
The famous casts are not people turned to stone.
Pompeii was not destroyed in one instant. It was destroyed in stages.
